lines: The real sun, for the day you watch

titles.name: Melbourne Bayside
titles.figures: 9,335 buildings · 7 km of shore · St Kilda to Brighton

titles.head: The bathing boxes
titles.text: 96 boxes, each on its own mapped footprint, on the Victorian Heritage Register since 2018.

titles.head: Mr Moon and the Scenic Railway
titles.text: Open since December 1912: 967 m of track, 16 m high, the oldest roller coaster still running.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Talk to the people who know the bay, walk the pier, wait for the penguins after dark.

titles.head: The little penguins
titles.text: About 1,400 live in the rocks of the 1956 Olympic breakwater and come ashore after sunset.

titles.name: Melbourne Bayside
titles.line: The model, the sun and the city: open them.
